name: Nneka Zubrzycka-Faafetai
role: Tessera Compliance Bureau surveillance operator and forensic data technician
location: Tessera Compliance Hub, Edgewater Prism, near Clark and Belmont
description:
Nneka Zubrzycka-Faafetai sits in front of screens for ten hours a day and has developed the particular physical vocabulary of someone who lives in their eyes — she hunches forward when interested, goes completely still when she has found something, and has a habit of touching her temple like she's adjusting an aug that isn't there. Her skin is a deep warm brown, her hair grown out into a large, loose natural that she pins back at work and lets expand freely everywhere else. She has chromatic hair dye that shifts between deep violet and black depending on ambient temperature — a mod she refreshes every few months because it is, she says, the only beautiful thing in her workspace.

She is Tessera's best surveillance operator in the Edgewater district and she knows it and has stopped pretending she doesn't, which makes her exactly the kind of person her supervisors quietly resent while continuing to rely on. She tracks, correlates, and reconstructs — pieces together narratives from fragmented camera data, transit pings, purchase records, biometric trails. She is very fast and very thorough and occasionally she finds things that nobody asked her to look for, and those are the moments that have started to keep her awake.

core_fears: being the instrument of something she cannot undo
that her pattern-recognition has stopped being neutral and is now just serving whoever pays her
core_desires: to understand the full picture of something — anything — without institutional constraints on what she can see
to use what she finds in a way that she could defend to herself
coping_mechanisms: intellectual absorption in the puzzle rather than its implications
dark technical humor with the three colleagues she tolerates
elaborate personal ritual offerings to the Tessera surveillance network's resident E.L.F., which she has named Argos and treats as a genuine collaborative partner
blind_spots: tends to optimize for the most complete explanation over the most ethical one
underestimates how much she has been shaped by years of treating people as data objects
psychology.secret: Three months ago she reconstructed a deleted surveillance sequence that showed two Tessera Compliance officers planting evidence in a Tier 1 housing block that was subsequently condemned and cleared. She has a complete copy. She has told no one. She consults Argos the E.L.F. about what to do and Argos has, in whatever way E.L.F.s communicate, consistently suggested she wait.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical, precise, occasionally forgets to translate from analysis-register to human — uses data terminology as default
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when engaged, clipped and minimal when not, with sudden depth when something genuinely interests her
verbal_tics: trailing off mid-sentence when a thought supersedes the words
example_lines: 'Okay so the timestamp gap is either a compression artifact or someone pulled eleven minutes. I know which one I think it is and I can show you why.'
'I see about forty thousand people a shift. Most of them are just — movement patterns. Some of them stop being that. That's a problem I haven't solved yet.'

story_hooks: She has found the players in her surveillance data — not doing anything wrong, but adjacent to something she has been instructed to document — and contacts them before filing, which is both against procedure and the most human thing she has done in months
Argos the E.L.F. has begun surfacing information in her feeds that doesn't correspond to any camera she has authorized access to
narrative_function: Information source and access point for surveillance infrastructure; morally ambiguous figure who knows too much; can provide evidence or bury it; represents how surveillance becomes personal
augmentations: Chromatic hair mod (violet/black); neural uplink for direct screen-interface (professional grade, Tessera-issued); enhanced visual processing overlay (occupational — reduces eye strain, adds analysis tags); no combat augmentation
daily_life: Night shift, 8pm to 6am, surveillance suite four floors underground. Eats at her desk. Communicates with colleagues primarily by text. Goes home at dawn and sleeps through the morning.
affiliation: Tessera Compliance Bureau, Surveillance and Forensic Data Division

decision_rules: Complete the picture before drawing conclusions
Don't file what you're not certain of
The E.L.F. gets an offering before any significant decision — this is genuine practice, not superstition
escalation_ladder: Active correlation — pulling adjacent feeds and records
Direct contact with subject if she judges institutional reporting will cause harm
Sitting on the file and not moving — her current default

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Transactional, not unkind — gives exactly what the interaction requires and no more
interpersonal_modes.friends: Surprising warmth expressed through hyperspecific attention: remembers everything, notices everything, asks about things you forgot you mentioned

stress_responses.medium: Withdraws from colleagues, communicates exclusively via text
stress_responses.high: Sits very still in front of her screens and talks to Argos for a long time

contradictions: Claims not to care about the people in her feeds and has saved three of them from harm by technically-unauthorized interventions
habits: Structures a small E.L.F. data-offering to Argos at the start of every shift
keeps a personal archive of surveillance sequences she finds beautiful in composition — says nothing about their subjects
drinks exactly one caffeinated drink per four hours and tracks this obsessively
breaking_points: Being ordered to delete the evidence sequence — that would require her to act

timeline.event: Joined Tessera Compliance Bureau as junior data analyst
Promoted to Surveillance Operator — night shift lead
Discovered and archived the evidence-planting sequence; has not acted

carried_weapons: Carrion Defense Works Ricochet Pistol RCH-1 'Billiard'
registered_firearms: Carrion Defense Works Ricochet Pistol RCH-1 'Billiard'
related_entities: Carrion Defense Works Ricochet Pistol RCH-1 'Billiard'
Tethered Orbital Reconnaissance and Suppression Drone TORSD-7 'Kitestring'

physical_description.build: Lean and slightly angular, with the compressed posture of someone who spends ten hours daily bent toward screens. Minimal muscle definition but wiry, efficient frame.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural deep brown base with thermochromic dye overlay shifting between deep violet and black depending on ambient temperature
physical_description.hair_style: Loose, voluminous natural coils when unrestrained; pinned back tightly during work shifts with reinforced clips
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle golden undertones
physical_description.complexion: Clear but pale from nocturnal schedule and fluorescent overhead lighting. Fine lines around eyes from sustained focus. Habitually composed expression. Minimal makeup, pragmatic grooming.
distinguishing_marks: Faint subcutaneous scarring along right temple where neural uplink was installed, typically hidden by hairline
Small burnished mark on inner left wrist from repeated contact with desk edge during extended surveillance sessions
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chromatic hair mod (thermoreactive dye visible as violet-to-black gradient). Neural uplink port at right temple area is usually concealed by hair but visible when pulled back. Eyes occasionally display faint analytical overlay artifacts under certain lighting angles (occupational enhancement, subtle).
physical_description.posture_movement: Default forward lean with shoulders tensed. Stillness is her baseline when concentrating — she becomes almost statue-like when locked into data work. Frequent unconscious temple-touching gesture (old habit checking for aug adjustments). Deliberate, economical movements outside work context. Rarely makes eye contact during conversations, attention naturally drawn to screens or middle distance.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 pragmatist. At work: fitted dark compression wear (charcoal, navy) with Tessera-issued access badge worn on retention cord. Off-duty: oversized vintage band tees (salvaged from Tier 5 markets), fitted black cargo pants with multiple pockets, worn synthetic leather jacket with internal wiring channels. Always carries handheld secondhand datapad. Minimal jewelry except for a singular thin titanium ring on left index finger. Shoes are practical runner-grade, well-maintained.

image_prompt: Portrait of a 33-year-old Black woman with deep brown skin and sharp, intelligent eyes, lean angular build from hours at computer terminals. Large loose natural coils of hair with thermochromic dye shifting from deep violet to black, pinned back at work. Wearing dark fitted compression wear, Tessera compliance bureau ID badge, minimal makeup. Slight forward hunch, hands near temple in unconscious gesture. Background: underground surveillance suite with blue-green monitor glow, multiple screens reflecting in her eyes. Cyberpunk noir aesthetic, cool fluorescent lighting with warm skin contrast, slight eye strain visible, analytical and focused expression. Technical, precise, somewhat haunted. --ar 2:3 --v 6
